ability.name: Horribly Resilient
ability.effect: Heal (D3) this unit. If this unit is not a **^^Hero^^**, **Heal (2D3)** this unit instead.

ability.name: Savage Abomination
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** melee weapons.

ability.name: Revered Monstrosity
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made with **Companion** weapons by other friendly non‑**^^Unique Flesh-eater Courts Monsters^^** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
